previousCandidates.note: Published as the v1.0.0 release asset on 2026-09-21; kept for history.

gates.rationale: Passed on 2026-09-21 by the responsible party (Gabriel Worm) on the installed candidate: Live 12.4.15b3 Beta on Windows 11, desktop Chrome and Android phone on the same Wi-Fi. Owner acceptance sessions 2026-09-19 (F-001..F-010 recorded in Workflow Main task rc-surface-v1-stage-acceptance-2026-09-18) and 2026-09-21 (all ten findings re-verified fixed; seven further defects found and fixed the same day: hand-specific gestures, CFG shape hot-swap, bench client/host, AbletonOSC listener re-registration x2, on-demand selection, Receiver v2.2 auto-arm; sine/triangle/ramp_up/ramp_down/square accepted in recorded automation; SYNC 1/4 at 120 and 60 BPM; TRN beat flash and play/stop after a full Live restart; trigger note through Receiver v2.2 without clicking; CFG/MAP/PERF/MIX/SNP/SNS/AUD/VID smoke). Write-ceiling bench P04 measured (internal/LIVE-WRITE-CEILING-1.0.md section 3): 48 writes/s single-flight, 181/s with 4 in flight, 0 failures in 12 cells, LFO_SHAPE_MAX_HZ unchanged. Terminal checks: no UDP 9000 listener; panel 403 without/with controller token and 200 with admin token; panel assets public and token-free; /diag/echo over LAN originCheck.ok, role controller, token valid. Not executed, by owner decision: automation point count per bar, LFO actuator-stats window, 20-30 min long session, mixer-volume bench target (not exposed by getDeviceParams). Scope accepted as 'functional for a public 1.0'; field reports will drive follow-ups.

Route 1 chosen by the responsible party on 2026-09-21 (Workflow Main task rc-surface-release-prep-2026-09-21): the Ableton Extensions SDK/CLI tarballs are no longer tracked (vendor/*.tgz in .gitignore, git rm --cached), vendor/manifest.json records their names, sizes and SHA256, `npm run check:vendor` (scripts/check-vendor-sdk.mjs) verifies local copies, and both GitHub workflows stage the tarballs from the private repository ntworm/rc-surface-vendor through a read-only deploy key (secret VENDOR_SDK_KEY) before npm ci; the private repository, deploy key and secret were created on 2026-09-21 on the owner's order. The SDK stays tree-shaken inside the .ablx, which the licence permits. Known limitation recorded in internal/DISTRIBUTION-REVIEW-1.0.md section 6: commits reachable from origin/main since 0ea728c (v0.6.0, 2026-08-01) still contain the tarballs; a history repair is a separate owner decision and is not required by this gate.
Source r13 consolidated onto the worktree; SHA256 verified across all 367 files; internal/RELEASE-BASELINE-1.0.md documents the baseline.
Bundle inventory closed; internal/DISTRIBUTION-REVIEW-1.0.md plus docs/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES{.md,.pt-BR.md} match the bundle; npm audit --omit=dev reports 0 vulnerabilities.

RcSensorCapabilities module enforces capability, permission, and freshness checks; suspension/resume never prompts; calibration requires 3 finite axes within the freshness window. Mutation tests confirmed the guards.

sendWithBackpressure replaces ws.send for telemetry/critical frames; admins preserved; per-client exceptions isolated; tests cover limits 512 KiB+1, OPEN/CLOSING, fast+slow coexistence, 600 KiB critical, 3 MiB disconnect, reconnect restores state.
noUnusedLocals + noUnusedParameters in tsconfig; ESLint strict block for ~22 encapsulated modules; 35 -> 7 unused-vars warnings removed; internal/CODE-HYGIENE-1.0.md documents removals.

src/osc-tokens.ts registers all LISTEN/GET/CMD/RESPONSE OSC addresses; src/live/osc-transport.ts imports the registry rather than string-literal addresses; 14 new tests cover wire bounds, OSC registry, transport-clock ceilings, controls.js tables, hello tolerance, unknown keys, rate limiter, hello field preservation.

8 perf tests pass: snapshot payload, broadcast rate 2 Hz, 16-client fan-out, backpressure headroom, 2x envelope peak, refill after sustained overload, bucket capacity, nominal envelope + sustained ~300/s.

Zero drift markers (MIX 6+6, Follow Action, mock-server, sim-phone, test-commands, test-admin-broadcast, udp-midi) across docs/{index.html,USER-GUIDE{,.pt-BR}.md,FAQ{,.pt-BR}.md,INSTALL{,.pt-BR}.md,CONTRACTS{,.pt-BR}.md,internal/TESTER-GUIDE.md}. USER-GUIDE describes current XR/12-pad/dual-stick pattern. Landing parity 27/27.

scripts/sync-tester-kit.mjs (slices A/B/R), scripts/build-host-locally.sh, scripts/lima-{audio-sender,midi-receiver}.sh. Slice R is opt-in (only writes local AppData when ABLETON_RC_DEV_SYNC is set); neither git nor the ableton-store is touched.

scripts/verify-release.mjs runs the local-only release verification flow (CI + package + gates). The package verifier accepts --package, --build-dir, --report and refuses packagePath with '..'. The gates document records every gate with explicit status; unknown statuses cannot be converted into pass.

Owner acceptance on 2026-09-29 (Gabriel Worm) of bench package 245D7C6E (SHA256 245D7C6E8B71F9638D0DDF7B12F539CF6DA80C89E65BC80BB0696426291D0D6F, source dd83dd6, manifest 1.0.0) on physical hardware: temporary hand loss holds, retrigger and note timing, Bind/Trigger Note editor and aligned curve handles. Presets were deferred by the owner and not tested. The 1.0.1 candidate has the same 91 package entries with identical content except manifest.json version (entry-by-entry SHA256 comparison); the 1.0.1 file itself was not reinstalled on hardware, so this gate does not claim a separate hardware session for it. The 2026-09-21 physical-hardware gate above remains the 1.0.0 record.
